entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 500 aa protein; estimated molecular mass 51.99 kDa and theoretical pI 5.62.
Pfam domains: Mur_ligase PF01225 at residues 23–92, Mur_ligase_M PF08245 at 113–315, and Mur_ligase_C PF02875 at 338–469.
Best reviewed homologs are MurE ligases with 43.7–48.4% identity and 94.4–98.2% query coverage.

Likely cytosolic, ATP-dependent UDP-MurNAc-tripeptide synthetase that incorporates meso-diaminopimelate; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homologs rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: EC 6.3.2.13; catalyzes addition of meso-2,6-diaminopimelate to UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate.
Requires ATP and Mg2+; participates in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis and is generally cytosolic.
Reference homologs contain a conserved C-terminal meso-diaminopimelate-recognition motif and an N6-carboxylysine modification site.

entities.name: MurE DAP ligation reaction
observations: Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE ligase adds the third amino-acid residue, meso-diaminopimelate, to the UDP-linked peptidoglycan precursor before subsequent cell-wall assembly steps.
